decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and utilize its ability to deal damage. It includes a mix of spells to control the board, draw cards, and protect key cards like Thing in the Ice. Otawara, Soaring City provides additional flying threats, while Temporal Trespass offers a big finisher. The deck aims to be aggressive and efficient, using a combination of burn spells and card draw to overwhelm the opponent and win quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently search for and play powerful creatures and spells, controlling the board and generating value over time. It includes a variety of versatile creatures, enchantments, and lands to support this strategy, with the option to play Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong presence on the battlefield, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of control elements and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by combining enchantment-based removal and powerful creatures with Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor up threats and answers from the deck. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as both a companion and a way to flicker important permanents for added value. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into big threats like Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Titan of Industry. By utilizing a mix of enchantments, creatures, and lands, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and take over the game with its versatile toolbox of cards.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan while Haunted Ridge provides additional damage. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser offer graveyard synergies to grind out longer games. Removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore help maintain board control. The deck's mana base includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Castle Locthwain, as well as some dual lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in its strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive Spirit creature strategy. By playing powerful Spirit creatures like Ascendant Spirit and Supreme Phantom, as well as utilizing cards like Geistlight Snare and Shacklegeist for control, you can quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to your opponent. In addition, cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor provide card advantage and additional utility to help maintain your tempo and outpace your opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that puts pressure on the opponent. It includes a mix of graveyard recursion with Satyr Wayfinder and Witherbloom Command, as well as disruption with Liliana of the Veil and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes some utility cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Tasigur, the Golden Fang to provide additional options. The mana base is designed to support the deck's requirements, with a mix of dual lands and pathways to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures and using cards like Collected Company to swarm the opponent with threats. The goal is to apply pressure early and often, overwhelming the opponent with a mix of flying Angels and other resilient creatures. The land base includes utility lands to provide extra benefits and ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the strategy is to beat down the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan while also maintaining some staying power through lifegain and efficient creatures.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice effects to control the board and pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar with Witch's Oven or Deadly Dispute, the deck gains advantage and triggers powerful abilities like Mayhem Devil's. Claim the Firstborn is used to steal key creatures from the opponent, while The Meathook Massacre can clear the board or finish off the opponent. The deck aims to build a strong sacrifice engine while applying pressure and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant. It also aims to generate value through creature tokens with cards like Esika's Chariot and Werewolf Pack Leader. The inclusion of burn spells like Obliterating Bolt helps to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also has some land utility with cards like Mutavault and Lair of the Hydra, as well as some powerful finishers like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful aggro strategy.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and apply pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Dreadbore and Fatal Push, while also having a strong late-game threat in Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck's mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells in a Rakdos color scheme. It aims to control the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while pressuring the opponent with fast threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also has some graveyard recursion with Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It also utilizes Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of Shark Typhoon provides a win condition and additional value. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can establish a dominant position. The mana base includes utility lands like Castle Vantress and Field of Ruin to interact with opponents' lands. Overall, the deck is built around control elements to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field and various untap effects to generate a large amount of mana quickly. Using cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings, the deck can untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn to produce massive amounts of mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience, allowing the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent with a large number of threats or game-ending combos. The deck also includes effects like Bala Ged Recovery and Dark Petition to help find key pieces of the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through green devotion creatures and lands to support powerful green spells and abilities. It utilizes creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Lovestruck Beast alongside mana accelerators like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to quickly overwhelm opponents with large threats. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator help to maintain board presence and provide additional flexibility in dealing with opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently generate mana and deploy powerful threats to control the pace of the game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a swarm of Elves while utilizing cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to bring out key creatures. The focus is on developing a strong board presence and using cards like Shaman of the Pack to deal damage and finish off the opponent. Mana acceleration is essential with cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to allow for explosive plays. Overall, the strategy is to build a powerful Elf army and apply pressure early in the game.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to combo off and create powerful creatures or game-winning situations. The deck focuses on creativity and thinking outside the box to outmaneuver opponents. By using a mixture of control elements like Negate and removal spells like Fiery Impulse, the deck aims to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Secrets of the Key and Valakut Awakening provide card advantage and digging through the deck to find key pieces for the combo.
